    "cat = pd.Categorical(metadata['cell.type'])\n",

    "label_pick = [i for i, name in enumerate(cat.categories) if name in picked_cell_type]\n",
    "\n",
    "from collections import defaultdict\n",
    "def sampling(source, num_sample, label_pick):\n",
    "    class_indices = defaultdict(list)\n",
    "    for idx, label in enumerate(source):\n",
    "        class_indices[label].append(idx)\n",
    "\n",
    "    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42)  # Set a seed for reproducibility\n",
    "    sampled_indices = []\n",
    "    for label, indices in class_indices.items():\n",
    "        if label in label_pick:\n",
    "            n_class_samples = min(len(indices), num_sample)  # Equal sampling\n",
    "            sampled_indices.extend(list(rng.choice(indices, n_class_samples, replace=False)))\n",
    "    return sampled_indices\n",
    "\n",

write_file({"relative_path":"workspace/sample_c_elegans.py","content":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# URLs from docs/tutorials/c_elegans.ipynb
metadata_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisrs1128/distortions-data/main/data/c-elegans_qc_final_metadata.txt"

# cell types to sample
picked = ["Ciliated_amphid_neuron", "Pharyngeal_neuron", "GLR", "Glia",
          "Body_wall_muscle", "Pharyngeal_muscle","Hypodermis", "Intestine"]

metadata = pd.read_csv(metadata_url, sep=",")

col = 'cell.type'
if col not in metadata.columns:
    # try alternative column names
    for c in metadata.columns:
        if c.lower().startswith('cell'):
            col = c
            break

counts = metadata[col].value_counts()

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
selected_idx = []
per_type_counts = {}
for t in picked:
    inds = metadata.index[metadata[col] == t].tolist()
    n = min(100, len(inds))
    if n > 0:
        chosen = rng.choice(inds, size=n, replace=False).tolist()
    else:
        chosen = []
    selected_idx.extend(chosen)
    per_type_counts[t] = len(chosen)

total = len(selected_idx)
print('per_type_counts:', per_type_counts)
print('total_sampled:', total)
"})
